_about: The test-links page (test-links.html) reads this list: Karl's change list. Live = on the site for everyone. Testing = behind a flag, waiting for Karl to keep or retire it. Retired = deleted. Every build adds or updates its entries (CLAUDE.md, Working with Karl). Each entry is a name, one plain sentence (`about`) and, for Live and Testing, its buttons. A button's `query` is the part after the address: card, level, seed, flags, sign-in skipped. `level` in a link is the saved level number (Add to both sides and Divide it: link level 2 is shown as Level 1). `reset: true` clears this browser's progress first; `look` is one sentence on what to look for; `notLive` says plainly why a link won't work on the live site.

items.name: Errors pop up next to the mistake (spotlight)
items.about: A move that makes things worse dims the page, lights up what went wrong, and only Undo goes on; after Undo a hint pops up at the number to work on.

links.label: A move the wrong way
links.look: On x + 8 = −4, Add 8 and ✓: the page dims, +16 is lit with “got bigger”, the message sits beside it and Undo pulses. Press Undo (or Enter): a hint at the +8 with Got it.

links.label: Partly cancelled
links.look: Add −5 and ✓: the +3 still next to x is lit, “still here”.

links.label: A wrong guess
links.look: Type 4 and Check, click through: the “Not balanced” line is lit; Undo takes the guess back, then the hint.

links.label: A wrong value
links.look: Add −8, ✓, Next, then type 19 and Check, click through: x = is lit, “check this”; Undo closes it and says to work out x.

links.label: Divide: a fraction that doesn’t split
links.look: Take a fraction, ½: the failed row is lit, “doesn’t split”; after Undo the 5 is outlined and Take a fraction is highlighted.

items.name: Add to both sides: preview on hover, fill the blank
items.about: Every level now plays this way: hover Add to see the move on the equation, type the amount in the box in that row, then press the green Next.

links.label: Level 1 · x + 8 = 11
links.look: No Guess x / Use a move buttons: the line just says “Find x.”, and both Add and x = work at once.

links.label: Level 3 · x + 8 = −4
links.look: The same screen on the mixed level (it used to be the old screen).

links.label: Level 5 · bigger
links.look: The same screen on the last level.

items.name: Trade places when x is on the right
items.about: From Level 4, when x is on the right, the line asks you to trade places first; Add waits until you do.

links.label: Level 4 · −2 = x + −6
links.look: Click Add first: it says to trade places. Click the Trade places move (it pulses): the sides swap, then Add works.

items.name: The move after a correct guess
items.about: Guess right and the next problem must be shown with a move: the move has a steady ring and x = stays grey until you make one.

links.label: Guess, then the next problem
links.look: Type −12 and Check, click through, then Next problem: Add has a ring, x = is grey with “Make one move first.”, until a good move and Next.

items.name: Divide it: no choice
items.about: Divide it has no Guess x / Use a move either: the fraction move and x = are both live from the start.

links.label: Divide it · Level 2 · 5x = −15
links.look: The line says “Find x.”; you can type a guess or pick Take a fraction straight away.

items.name: Level 1 is problems; the walkthrough is “See why it works”
items.about: Add to both sides and Divide it open on real problems; the numbers-only walkthrough is a small button on the card.

links.label: Home screen, as a brand-new student
links.look: Hover Solve it: both cards start at Level 1 with a “See why it works” button by the dots. Open it, reload: you land on the home screen.

links.label: Add to both sides · See why it works
links.look: The header says “See why it works”: the balance walkthrough.

links.label: Divide it · See why it works
links.look: The header says “See why it works”: the numbers-only walkthrough.

items.name: Help that reads the equation on screen (Build A)
items.about: I'm stuck now uses the numbers on screen, says Undo first after a bad move, and never writes the answer.

links.label: Partly cancelled: Undo first
links.look: On x + 8 = −4 add −5 (✓), then I’m stuck: it names the +3 that’s left and says to press Undo first.

links.label: x alone: help with the sum
links.look: Add −8, Next, then I’m stuck twice at x = 11 + −8: the two numbers are outlined and it asks the sum; it never writes 3.

links.label: Divide it: a fraction that doesn’t split
links.look: On 5x = −15 take ½ (it fails), then I’m stuck: it says to press Undo first.

items.name: Every level
items.about: One button per level of the two Solve it cards, on the same problems every time.

items.name: Lights round 2: the narrow panel
items.about: Four small moves and round dots that open into their goal on hover or tap; the equation reads x − 4 and the dashed line runs in front of the =.

links.label: Narrow panel · x − 4 = −3
links.look: Hover a dot: it opens into its goal. Note the = with the line through it.

items.name: Lights round 2: grab the terms
items.about: Drag a number across the line to add its opposite to both sides, onto another number to combine them, or along its side to reorder; tap a minus to see it as a negative.

links.label: Drag across, combine, minus
links.look: Drag “− 4” over the line (it turns into “+ 4 ⇄”), drop, Next, then drop the 4 onto the −3 and type 1.

links.label: Reorder, and x can’t cross
links.look: Drag “+ 8” before x: 8 + x = 11 in place. Drag x across: “That moves x. Try the number.”

items.name: Lights round 2: the Distribute drill
items.about: Two drill problems solved only by grabbing terms: tap the minus, drag −2 onto the parentheses, type each product.

links.label: Drill: 5 − 2(x + 2) = 3
links.look: Dragging the 2 is refused until you tap its minus; then two labelled blanks, −2 and −4, and on to x = −1.

items.name: Guess x / Use a move
items.about: The choice at the start of every Solve it problem is deleted on Add to both sides and Divide it (Build C).

items.name: The tucked layout
items.about: The Divide it pilot with the slim Why? column, Moves drawer and counter tray (?layout=tucked) is deleted (Build C).

items.name: The ?ui=lights link
items.about: Not needed any more: what it showed is now how Add to both sides always plays (see Live).

items.name: The move owed on the same problem
items.about: Lights round 1 asked for the move on the same problem after a correct guess; now it is the next problem, as everywhere else.
